name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.78 / build 79 makes staff-chat ratings and comments optional, allows conversations to end without feedback and keeps Back/Close available after failed or pending feedback. Optional feedback has balanced controls and comment-only feedback is not treated as a negative rating. Patient-facing support labels now read Staff Support and Talk to Staff Support. Existing saved conversations, booking and SMAPE/MAPE features are retained. Requires the matching optional-feedback backend update. Existing development/test signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation, native on-device interaction and actual patient push delivery were not verified.
